```{r}
library(rentrez)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)


# Create output folder
dir.create("out3", showWarnings = FALSE)


# PubMed search:
# UC/IBD + colorectal cancer + early detection + AI/ML/DL

search_term <- paste(
  
  "(ulcerative colitis OR inflammatory bowel disease OR IBD)",
  
  "AND",
  
  "(Dysplasia OR colorectal cancer OR colitis-associated cancer OR colorectal neoplasia)",
  
  "AND",
  
  "(early detection OR early diagnosis OR screening OR surveillance OR prediction OR risk prediction OR diagnostic model OR biomarker)",
  
  "AND",
  
  "(Statistical model OR artificial intelligence OR AI OR machine learning OR deep learning OR neural network OR random forest OR XGBoost OR support vector machine OR transformer OR CNN)",
  
  "AND",
  
  '("2020/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2026/12/31"[Date - Publication])'
  
)


search <- entrez_search(
  db = "pubmed",
  term = search_term,
  retmax = 1500,
  sort = "pub date"
)


pmids <- search$ids

length(pmids)



# Fetch papers

fetch_paper <- function(id){

  s <- entrez_summary(
    db="pubmed",
    id=id
  )

  data.frame(
    PMID = id,
    Title = s$title,
    Journal = s$fulljournalname,
    Year = substr(s$pubdate,1,4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

}


papers <- map_dfr(pmids, fetch_paper)


head(papers)



# Categorize AI methods

papers$AI_Method <- "Other"


papers$AI_Method[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "machine learning|ml"
  )
] <- "Machine Learning"


papers$AI_Method[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "deep learning|neural network|cnn|transformer"
  )
] <- "Deep Learning"



papers$AI_Method[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "artificial intelligence| ai "
  )
] <- "Artificial Intelligence"



papers$AI_Method[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "random forest"
  )
] <- "Random Forest"



papers$AI_Method[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "xgboost|gradient boosting"
  )
] <- "XGBoost"



papers$AI_Method[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "support vector|svm"
  )
] <- "SVM"




# Early detection category

papers$Detection_Type <- "Other"


papers$Detection_Type[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "screening|surveillance"
  )
] <- "Screening/Surveillance"



papers$Detection_Type[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "early detection|early diagnosis"
  )
] <- "Early Detection"



papers$Detection_Type[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "prediction|risk prediction"
  )
] <- "Prediction"



papers$Detection_Type[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "biomarker|marker"
  )
] <- "Biomarker"



# Save complete dataset

write.csv(
  papers,
  file="out3/PubMed_AI_EarlyDetection_IBD_CRC.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)



##############################
# Figure 1 Publication Trend
##############################

fig1 <- papers %>%
  count(Year) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x=Year,y=n)
  )+
  geom_col(fill="steelblue")+
  geom_text(
    aes(label=n),
    vjust=-0.4
  )+
  theme_classic(base_size=14)+
  labs(
    title="AI-based Early Detection of IBD-associated Colorectal Cancer",
    x="Publication Year",
    y="Number of Publications"
  )


ggsave(
  "out3/Figure1_Publication_Trend.png",
  fig1,
  width=8,
  height=5,
  dpi=300
)



##############################
# Figure 2 AI Method Distribution
##############################

fig2 <- papers %>%
  count(AI_Method, sort=TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      reorder(AI_Method,n),
      n
    )
  )+
  geom_col(fill="darkred")+
  coord_flip()+
  theme_bw(base_size=13)+
  labs(
    title="AI Methods Used for Early Detection",
    x="AI Method",
    y="Number of Papers"
  )


ggsave(
  "out3/Figure2_AI_Methods.png",
  fig2,
  width=8,
  height=5,
  dpi=300
)



##############################
# Figure 3 Detection Strategy
##############################

fig3 <- papers %>%
  count(Detection_Type, sort=TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      reorder(Detection_Type,n),
      n
    )
  )+
  geom_col(fill="darkgreen")+
  coord_flip()+
  theme_classic(base_size=14)+
  labs(
    title="Early Detection Approaches",
    x="Detection Strategy",
    y="Number of Papers"
  )


ggsave(
  "out3/Figure3_Detection_Strategy.png",
  fig3,
  width=8,
  height=5,
  dpi=300
)



##############################
# Summary tables
##############################

write.csv(
  papers %>% count(Year),
  "out3/Publications_by_Year.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)



write.csv(
  papers %>% count(AI_Method, sort=TRUE),
  "out3/AI_Method_Summary.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)



write.csv(
  papers %>% count(Detection_Type, sort=TRUE),
  "out3/Early_Detection_Summary.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)



write.csv(
  papers %>% count(Journal, sort=TRUE),
  "out3/Journal_Summary.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)



##############################
# Export only AI papers
##############################

AI_papers <- papers %>%
  filter(
    AI_Method!="Other"
  )


write.csv(
  AI_papers,
  "out3/AI_only_EarlyDetection_Papers.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)



print(head(AI_papers))
```



```{r}
##########################################
# Research Area Classification for AI Early Detection
##########################################

papers$Research_Area <- "Other"


papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "artificial intelligence|machine learning|deep learning|neural network|random forest|xgboost|svm|transformer|cnn"
  )
] <- "AI / Machine Learning"


# Proteomics
papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "proteomic|proteomics|protein|mass spectrometry|lc-ms|lc/ms|ms/ms|tmt|dia|swath|aptamer"
  )
] <- "Proteomics"


papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "screening|surveillance|colonoscopy|endoscopy|chromoendoscopy|nbi"
  )
] <- "Screening / Surveillance"


papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "prediction|risk model|risk score|nomogram|diagnostic model"
  )
] <- "Prediction Models"


papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "microbiome|microbiota|16s|metagenomic"
  )
] <- "Microbiome"


papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "rna|transcriptomic|gene expression|single cell"
  )
] <- "Transcriptomics"


papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "genomic|mutation|dna|sequencing"
  )
] <- "Genomics"


papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "histology|pathology|image analysis|digital pathology"
  )
] <- "Histology / Pathology"


papers$Research_Area[
  str_detect(
    tolower(papers$Title),
    "clinical|cohort|patient"
  )
] <- "Clinical"



##########################################
# Plot 1: Research Area Distribution
##########################################

p <- papers %>%
  filter(Research_Area != "Other") %>%
  count(Research_Area, sort=TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      reorder(Research_Area,n),
      n,
      fill=Research_Area
    )
  ) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  labs(
    x="Research Area",
    y="Number of Papers",
    title="Areas in AI-based Early Detection of IBD-associated CRC"
  )


print(p)


ggsave(
  filename="out3/research_area_AI_early_detection.png",
  plot=p,
  width=10,
  height=6,
  dpi=300
)



##########################################
# Plot 2: Research Area Trend Over Years
##########################################

p_year <- papers %>%
  filter(Research_Area!="Other") %>%
  count(Year, Research_Area) %>%
  
  ggplot(
    aes(
      Year,
      n,
      fill=Research_Area
    )
  ) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw(base_size=14) +
  labs(
    x="Publication Year",
    y="Number of Papers",
    fill="Research Area",
    title="Trends of AI-based Early Detection Research"
  )


print(p_year)



ggsave(
  filename="out3/research_area_by_year_AI.png",
  plot=p_year,
  width=10,
  height=6,
  dpi=300
)
```

```{r}
library(tidytext)


############################################
# Keyword frequency analysis from titles
############################################

biomed_stopwords <- data.frame(
  word = c(
    "patient",
    "patients",
    "study",
    "studies",
    "using",
    "based",
    "associated",
    "analysis",
    "clinical",
    "data",
    "model",
    "models",
    "review",
    "new",
    "role",
    "approach"
  )
)



pp <- papers %>%
  
  unnest_tokens(
    word,
    Title
  ) %>%
  
  anti_join(
    stop_words,
    by="word"
  ) %>%
  
  anti_join(
    biomed_stopwords,
    by="word"
  ) %>%
  
  count(
    word,
    sort=TRUE
  ) %>%
  
  slice(1:20) %>%
  
  ggplot(
    aes(
      reorder(word,n),
      n
    )
  )+
  
  geom_col(
    fill="orange"
  )+
  
  coord_flip()+
  
  theme_bw(
    base_size=13
  )+
  
  labs(
    x="Keywords",
    y="Number of Publications",
    title="Key-words in Early Detection of IBD-associated CRC"
  )


print(pp)



############################################
# Save figure
############################################

ggsave(
  filename = "out3/Research_Topic_Keywords_AI_EarlyDetection.png",
  plot = pp,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)



############################################
# Save final dataset
############################################

write.csv(
  papers,
  "out3/IBD_CRC_AI_EarlyDetection_PubMed_Papers.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

category_table <- papers %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_Papers = n(),
    PMIDs = paste(PMID, collapse = "; "),
    Years = paste(Year, collapse = "; "),
    Journals = paste(Journal, collapse = "; "),
    Titles = paste(Title, collapse = " | "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

category_table

write.csv(category_table,
          "Category_Summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
